desc: 冷瓷灰拉丝钢面加洋红单点，背侧轮廓光九屏学饮杯详情
leaf: 婴幼儿学饮吸管杯（防尘圆顶罩配软质吸管嘴）
name: 瓷灰铬面洋红学饮杯款

shots.intent: 用拉丝钢面加背侧轮廓光把一只合罩的学饮杯从满屏粉色海报同类里拔出来，靠金属与玻璃的冷面质感和一道洋红短划在首屏换停留与点击
shots.textZone: 右上方瓷灰场留白带放一行主标与其下一对压在灰规则线上的洋红短划，其下一行小一号副标，钢面前缘玻璃带上反白一行微型标签

shots.intent: 把源图那排写着耐热食品级不含铅不含铬的圆形图标整排删掉，换成拉丝钢面灰规则线上四组洋红短划与四个完全空白的疑问位，只搭框架不复述任何功效
shots.textZone: 上方瓷灰场一行小标题与一行小一号副标，其下一条灰规则线上四组洋红短划，四枚留白位各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图两块空白卡配硅胶吸管可用三年与韧性抗氧化的杜撰结论改成一格立本品一格整块留给卖家自贴的双格钢面对照，同一道背侧轮廓光不偏袒，杜绝虚构对比与数值
shots.textZone: 顶部一行对照小标题压一对洋红短划，左格一整块 porcelain 留白板，两格各一条空白标签线挂在灰发丝引线上

shots.intent: 把源图露脸与幼儿独握的喂水暗示改写成冷光下一双成人的手抱着婴儿、合罩的杯立在钢面与一件无字铬器之间，让买家代入又不越界、不出现任何口腔接触
仰视微距交代圆顶罩、顶点按弹钮、铬瓶口环与坐在罩内的软质吸管嘴的装配关系，用三枚洋红短划引线撑起做工信任而不写任何结构与功效
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行冷炭结构小标题带一对洋红短划，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 正侧面交代蛋形瓶身与圆顶罩的比例关系，把源图各处毫升数与毫米数全改成一条无字标尺与三枚洋红短划引线，只留空白标签不写任何数字
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在洋红短划引线上，顶部一行轮廓小标题带一对洋红短划

shots.intent: 把源图散落两处的高低两只同款收进一枚选款屏，只列参考图确有的一高一矮两只与两种瓶口环色调，不写毫升数也不新造第三配色
shots.textZone: 上方一行选款小标题与一行小一号副标，其下一条灰规则线上两组洋红短划，两组各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图那页填了品牌名称容量重量尺寸颜色的参数表与三行拉丁底纹细节改成钢面上一张瓷灰卡里的五行空白档案加一整块留证位，字段名与数值一律留空由卖家自行合贴真实资料
shots.textZone: 卡顶一行小标题与一行小一号副标，其下五行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），卡底一整块空白留证位，全部条目文字占位

shots.intent: 以三十度俯角在洋红短划与玻璃暗带边收口整套瓷灰铬面视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚留白标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部瓷灰留白带放结束标题、一行小一号副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白洋红短划标签线，钢面前缘一条带两组短划的灰规则线

style.presentationRules: the squat egg-shaped cup stands upright at a stable scale on the brushed plate with its clear dome overcap fully fitted over the chrome collar ring and the soft straw-and-spout fully seated and secured inside the closed dome in every screen; the body silhouette from its soft shoulder down to the rounded base, the base radius, the dome height, the small press nub at the dome apex, the collar ring in its exact reference tone, the narrow seal band under the ring and the short curved straw with its soft spout head are never redrawn, resized, simplified, straightened or relocated; the reference set shows two heights of the same model with two collar tones, and only those may appear together, while no third colourway, no extra accessory, no spare straw and no handle is ever invented or named in words; no graduation or measuring scale is visible on the frosted body in the reference, so none is drawn, added, extended or implied anywhere in the set; any printed motif on the body front keeps its exact reference placement and scale while all wording inside the label area always reads as one blank legible field carrying no redrawn text; the product never floats, always keeps its hairline contact shadow, is never occluded by props or by a leader line, vertical lines and the plate edge stay strictly vertical, the rim is always from behind-right, and one real unmarked polished steel object stays in every scene screen to anchor scale honestly
style.surfaceSystem: the brushed stainless plate reading approximately #9AA0A6 is the only standing surface and the polished glass strip #12151A only ever appears below its front edge: real anisotropic brushed grain running one single direction, a crisp machined front edge, the cup settling onto it with visible weight so one hairline contact shadow sits under the rounded base and no part of the cup floats; metal is always lit by grazing light so the grain reads, never painted flat; the clear dome overcap is real thick-wall transparent stock with believable refraction, edge darkening and one internal caustic where it crosses the straw, never a frosted matte surface and never a mirror; the frosted translucent body is true diffusion with the inner straw faintly readable through it, never glossy plastic; the chrome collar ring is polished metal with a readable step edge, never soft rubber; the glass band is dry polished glass with no wet surface, no standing water, no droplet and no smudge
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans family at a light-to-regular display weight with generous letter-spacing; one short headline in cold charcoal #2B2F35 set flush left on the porcelain field #D6D8DC, reversed to #F0F2F4 whenever the copy crosses the glass band #12151A, with one pair of short accent #D4116E slashes cut across a grey #9AA0A6 hairline placed directly under the headline as the only decoration; one short sub-line in the same family one size step smaller, two to four short labels at most, micro-labels in #9AA0A6, per-screen copy budget held to one headline plus one sub-line plus the reserved labels and no dense body text; never a heavy slab or bubble display letter, never a cartoon outline letter or drop-shadowed type, never a serif or Ming face, never a Latin overprint word or a wide-tracked small-caps kicker line, never a handwritten body line, never a keyword highlighter band, never a boxed headline frame, never a pill or capsule badge, never a folded ribbon tag, never a second font
